gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has generous openings, like a chisel notch in wood, and small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals. Coming Soon is the casual one, loose and personal, while the sans keeps things tidy.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki lets light through its wide exits and gives every e a large, clear eye, which feels modern and tidy. Coming Soon, by contrast, pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Loose handwriting meets tidy sans. Coming Soon draws its lines with no hairline-to-stem shift, and Noto Sans Khudawadi follows with rounds left unlatched like a hook, plus little gap between capital height and lowercase.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR reads clean and contemporary, with generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders tucked beside a big x-height. Coming Soon earns its keep big and short, its handwritten strokes never thickening or thinning.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao reads modern and open, with an x-height pushed well above the usual and mouths that stay wide on c, e and a. Its long lines move along smoothly, while Coming Soon's round letters add a handwritten note.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: Words in Noto Sans Lao Looped read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Noto Sans Lao Looped is the steady half, while Coming Soon bends like a paperclip.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Coming Soon writes like pen on paper, its bowls and stems drawn at one weight, with a lowercase that climbs close to capitals. Noto Sans Lepcha counters with wide-opening curves and a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals, so give it room.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape wide open, which feels contemporary and approachable. And Coming Soon, drawn in a single line weight, brings the casual handwriting that loosens the whole page.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Coming Soon is pen-and-paper casual, its joins staying full where strokes meet. Noto Sans Lisu then moves on quietly, with tiny gaps under its ascender tops and wide s curves that let paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Coming Soon keeps its stroke thickness without variation, a personal, handwritten voice with lowercase rising close to capitals. But shrink it small and that casual charm fades, and Noto Sans Lydian is already roomy enough at large sizes.
